scientific_integrity: The exact finite-dimensional identity, exponential law, and signed 1/d correction have an analytic proof. A standard-library checker corroborates 225 rational/numerical tests; finite tests are not a proof of the limit.
scientific_limitations: The flip parameter a is fixed and strictly positive; d>2a. No uniform-in-a assertion.
The initial law is the stationary fair-bit product; the target is one specified corner.
No full marked point-process law or nonstationary starting-state theorem is claimed.
Classical stationary renewal and generic extremal-index theory are prior background; historical priority of the specialization is not independently certified.
title: The persistent-corner passage law and its signed finite-dimension correction
